description: Views and edits .bflyt UI layouts: pane tree, textured preview, positions, sizes, colors and textures, like Switch Toolbox.
file.label: BFLYT file
empty: No .bflyt file in the project. Extract a layout.arc first (double-click it).
tree.label: Panes
canvas.label: Layout preview
error.not-bflyt: This file is not a valid BFLYT
prop.name: Name
fit.hint: Fit the layout in view (or double-click). Scroll to zoom, drag to move the view, drag the selected pane to move it, arrows to nudge it (Shift ×10).
save.hint: Save the .bflyt (Ctrl+S). Repack the layout.arc afterwards from the Archives widget.
saveFirst: Save or revert your changes before opening another file
error.name-too-long: A pane name is longer than 24 bytes
error.no-text-buffer: This text box has no text buffer to edit
tex.replace.hint: Pick an image (or drop one on the row). It is resized to the texture's size and re-encoded in its format, then written into the .bntx right away.
tex.replaced: {{name}} replaced ({{size}}). Repack the layout.arc to use it in game.
remove.control: {{name}} is used by a control of this layout (cnt1): deleting it could crash the game
remove.done: {{name}} deleted ({{count}} panes). Save to write it.
tex.add.hint: Pick an image and choose its format: it is written into timg/__Combined.bntx and added to this layout's texture list (save the layout to keep the list).
tex.add.title: Add a texture
tex.added: {{name}} added. Use it in a material, then save the layout and repack the layout.arc.
tex.noBntx: No .bntx in the timg folder of this archive
error.no-texture-list: This layout has no texture list (txl1) to add to
anim.label: Animation
error.not-bflan: This file is not a valid BFLAN
anim.noLayout: No layout found for {{name}} in the blyt folder
